summaryZh: INCEPTION research laboratory开发自主系统控制、优化与运行的理论和算法。研究应用结合自适应反馈控制、人工智能、博弈论、网络系统和混合动力学，例子包括机器人、能源与交通等信息物理系统、社会技术系统及生物工程系统。

evidence.quote: Intelligence, Control, and Adaptation (INCEPTION) research laboratory, which develops theory and algorithms for the control, optimization, and operation of autonomous systems.
Applications of interest typically incorporate adaptive feedback control
Jorge I. Poveda is Associate Professor at UC San Diego in the ECE Department. He is the director of the Intelligence, Control, and Adaptation (INCEPTION) research laboratory

He is the director of the Intelligence, Control, and Adaptation (INCEPTION) research laboratory, which develops theory and algorithms for the control, optimization, and operation of autonomous systems.

Applications of interest typically incorporate adaptive feedback control loops, artificial intelligence, game theory, network systems, and hybrid dynamics . Examples include robotic systems, cyber-physical systems (energy, transportation, aerospace), sociotechnical systems, and bioengineering systems.
